* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift, då dokumentation och kommunikation sker på båda språken

**Det är meriterande om du har:**

* Erfarenhet av elektronikkonstruktion

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

title: Gastronomisk Utvecklare till Werners Gourmetservice i Skara
description:
Har du en passion för mat, smaker och råvaror och drivs av att dela med dig av din kunskap? Vill du använda din erfarenhet som kock på ett nytt sätt – genom produktutveckling, utbildning och möten med människor i branschen?


Hos Werners Gourmetservice får du möjlighet att arbeta med ett unikt sortiment av högkvalitativa produkter och vara med och utveckla både vårt erbjudande och svensk gastronomi. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, kreativ och affärsmässig och som känner igen dig i våra värdeord modig, inspirerande och pålitlig.

**Om Werners Gourmetservice**


På Werners Gourmetservice drivs vi av att förverkliga smakupplevelser värda att minnas. Med kompetens, passion och en ständig nyfikenhet på nya smaker, råvaror och matupplevelser erbjuder vi ett relevant sortiment med starka varumärken och inspirerande produkter – med ambitionen att finnas på varje tallrik, varje bord och i varje kök.


Sedan 1990 har vi importerat noggrant utvalda produkter från hela världen till den nordiska marknaden. Vårt hjärta finns i Skara, där vårt Innovationscenter är en mötesplats för kunder, samarbetspartners och branschkollegor. Genom kunskap och nära samarbete med branschen vill vi bidra till en godare värld och gastronomins fortsatta utveckling.


Vi är cirka 50 medarbetare med kontor i Skara och Stockholm. Werners Gourmetservice ingår i KåKå Group, som är en del av Orkla Food Ingredients och Orkla-koncernen. Vår kultur präglas av entreprenörskap, framåtanda, utveckling och glädje.

**Om Werners Education**


Som Gastronomisk Utvecklare tillhör du Werners Education, vars ambition är att vara en självklar mötesplats för kunskap och inspiration. Här samlar vi kunder, leverantörer och andra aktörer genom utbildningar, kundaktiviteter och samarbeten som bidrar till kunskapsutbyte i branschen.


En viktig del av verksamheten är vårt Innovationscenter i Skara, där vi genomför utbildningar, kundaktiviteter och provsmakningar. Werners Education har också en central roll i sortimentsarbetet genom att testa och utvärdera produkter, utveckla recept och användningsområden samt fånga upp behov från kunder och bransch.

**Om tjänsten**


Som Gastronomisk Utvecklare driver och utvecklar du Werners gastronomiska erbjudande. Du ansvarar för våra utbildningar och gastronomiska aktiviteter och bidrar till att göra Innovationscentret i Skara till en levande mötesplats för kunder, leverantörer, branschkollegor och medarbetare.


Du är en viktig del av vårt innovations- och sortimentsarbete och testar och utvärderar både nya och befintliga produkter. Med din erfarenhet som kock utvecklar du recept, applikationer och koncept som visar produkternas möjligheter och hjälper våra kunder att använda dem på bästa sätt. Du medverkar också vid matfotograferingar och bidrar till hur våra produkter presenteras.


Tillsammans med Sälj och Marknad omsätter du din gastronomiska kompetens i kundnytta och affär. Det kan handla om kundmöten, produktlanseringar, kampanjer, mässor och event. Du utbildar våra medarbetare och är också en gastronomisk och teknisk produktexpert för både kunder och kollegor.


Det här är en roll med stor variation och många kontaktytor. Ena dagen håller du en utbildning i Skara, nästa testar du en ny produkt eller utvecklar ett recept och därefter möter du kunder tillsammans med en säljare.


**Vem trivs här?**


Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet som kock, gärna från en kvalitetsmedveten restaurangverksamhet, och ett stort intresse för råvaror, smaker och produkter. Du är nyfiken och kreativ, tycker om att testa nytt och drivs av att utveckla recept, användningsområden och idéer.


Du trivs också med att dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra. Att hålla en utbildning, möta en kund eller tillsammans med kollegor hitta den bästa lösningen känns naturligt för dig. Du är trygg i din yrkeskunskap, men samtidigt prestigelös och nyfiken på andras perspektiv.


Du har också ett kommersiellt tänk och förstår kopplingen mellan gastronomi och affär. Du ser hur rätt produkt och rätt kunskap kan skapa nytta för kunden och bidra till försäljning. Du tar initiativ, får saker att hända och kan växla mellan kreativitet och struktur.


Som person är du social, samarbetsinriktad och pålitlig. Med din kunskap, matglädje och ditt engagemang blir du en viktig ambassadör för Werners i mötet med kunder, leverantörer och branschen. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift. Du har goda kunskaper i Office-paketet. B-körkort är ett krav.  

  

**Vad erbjuder vi?**


Hos oss får du en varierad roll där du får kombinera din passion för mat med innovation, utbildning och affär. Du får arbeta med ett spännande sortiment av högkvalitativa produkter och har stor möjlighet att bidra med egna idéer och påverka vårt erbjudande.


Werners är ett mindre bolag med nära samarbeten, korta beslutsvägar och en varm företagskultur. Samtidigt är vi en del av KåKå Group och Orkla Food Ingredients, vilket ger tillgång till ett större nätverk och möjligheter till både personlig och professionell utveckling.


Du utgår från vårt kontor och Innovationscenter i Skara och rapporterar till Business Development Director KåKå Group. Tjänsten innebär resor, framför allt i samband med kundaktiviteter, utbildningar, mässor och event.

**Övrigt**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering i Skara. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.


Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Business Development Director Anna Bjur, anna.bjur@jastbolaget.se, eller HR-direktör Erica Fahlin, erica.fahlin@kaka.se.


Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post. Sista ansökningsdag är den 10 oktober 2026.

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**

* Stark kompetens inom SQL Server, med särskilt god erfarenhet av databasutveckling och optimering av lagrade procedurer.
* Goda kunskaper i Git samt erfarenhet av Azure DevOps (inklusive pipelines och CI/CD).

* Strukturerad och noggrann med ett öga för detaljer och kvalitet.
* Självständig och ansvarstagande med en naturlig drivkraft att föra projekt i mål.
* Kommunikativ lagspelare som trivs med att diskutera tekniska lösningar med både utvecklare och kollegor inom verksamheten.
* Nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med en vilja att ständigt lära dig nytt och utvecklas i din roll.

title: Master Developer Mechanical Design
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About this opportunity**


At Ericsson, we build the hardware behind the world's mobile networks — where mechanical reliability determines how products perform and survive years of temperature swings, power cycling, transport and demanding field environments.

  

We are now looking for a Master Developer in Mechanical Simulation & Reliability to become the technical anchor for structural and thermo-mechanical integrity across our radio and baseband hardware, within our Mechanical & Thermal Solutions department.

  

You will own and evolve our mechanical simulation and physics-of-failure methodology, be the person the organization turns to on its hardest reliability questions, and influence hardware design from early concept through verification and field-return root-cause analysis. You will work closely with thermal design, system, PCB/layout, verification and sourcing — influencing decisions early, where simulation has the greatest impact.

 **What you will do**  

* Lead advanced mechanical FEM and structural reliability assessments covering drop, shock, vibration, board-level dynamic response, and package/PCB deformation.
* Develop and apply advanced nonlinear thermo-mechanical FEM methodologies to predict solder-joint fatigue, package warpage, and long-term reliability under thermal and power cycling conditions.
* Develop mechanical simulation models to understand how product assembly processes, clamping, and thermal interface material (TIM) behavior induce stresses in component packages and solder joints.
* Correlate simulation results with physical testing, measurement data, and field returns to build trustworthy and defensible models, and support root-cause analysis of field and factory issues.
* Translate simulation insight into early design decisions, product requirements, design rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Own and continuously evolve the mechanical reliability simulation methodology, introducing new methods, models, and tools that strengthen the capability of the wider team.
* Drive the packaging technology area, including its technology roadmap, early technology development, and pre-development activities.
* Guide and mentor engineers, and represent mechanical reliability in discussions with designers, projects, technical leaders, and senior stakeholders.
**The skills you bring**  

We are looking for a recognized expert in mechanical simulation with a strong understanding of reliability physics — someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems and turning simulation into practical design guidance.


Essential experience:  

* Deep, demonstrated expertise in nonlinear structural and thermo-mechanical FEM. Depth of expertise and a strong track record matter more than years of experience alone.
* Strong proficiency in a leading FEM platform such as Ansys Mechanical, including advanced nonlinear, viscoplastic and creep material modelling.
* Strong understanding of reliability physics, including solder-joint fatigue, creep, damage mechanisms, acceleration factors and lifetime prediction.
* Experience in solder-joint, package and TIM modelling, including correlation of simulation results with measurements and physical testing.
* Ability to translate simulation insight into design decisions, design rules, product requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of relevant standards such as IPC-9701/9704, JEDEC/JESD22, Telcordia GR-63 (NEBS) and applicable IEC standards.
* Good understanding of electronics hardware, packaging and PCB assemblies, with the ability to collaborate closely with thermal, system, PCB/layout and mechanical design disciplines.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, mentor others and influence decisions across teams and disciplines.
  

It is a plus if you have experience with  

* Physics-of-failure and reliability tools such as Ansys Sherlock.
* TIM characterization, material modelling and measurement methods.
* Package warpage characterization, pad cratering, BGA corner-joint failure and other package/interconnect failure mechanisms.
* Board-level drop and shock simulation and correlation, as well as PCB fabrication, SMT assembly and reflow processes.
* Design of Experiments (DoE), surrogate or reduced-order models, digital twins, or AI/ML approaches for accelerating simulation and engineering analysis.
* Telecom/RAN or other long-life electronics hardware designed for demanding environments.
 **Who you are**  

You are curious about why hardware fails and motivated by turning simulation insight into designs that last.  

You are a natural technical leader who can make complex simulation understandable, challenge assumptions constructively and influence design decisions across disciplines.  

You also enjoy sharing your knowledge and helping others grow, and colleagues naturally turn to you when facing challenging reliability or mechanical design problems.

 **Why join us?**  

This is an opportunity to take a leading technical role in mechanical reliability for advanced telecom hardware, and to influence both the products we develop today and the technologies we will use tomorrow.


You will have the opportunity to:  

* Drive the packaging technology area and take a leading technical role in solder-joint reliability and robustness simulation.
* Influence design decisions early and help define the requirements and design rules that follow.
* Work closely with skilled experts across thermal, system, PCB, verification and other engineering disciplines.
* Develop new simulation methods and explore how automation and AI-assisted engineering can improve the way we work.
  

Join us and help build networks the world can depend on.

 **Why join Ericsson?**


At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.  

  

**What happens once you apply?**


Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. This team oversees the entire user journey on Spotify and ensures we engage with people in innovative ways, every step of the way. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
   

  

 As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.
   

  

 We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Architect, develop and operate Java services that serve our users through the merchandising platform to enable cohesive and relevant conversion and upsell journeys.
* Collaborate with our squad and key internal partners to determine how to design scalable backend systems, data models and APIs that run on Google Cloud Platform.
* Be a technical leader, mentor and valued contributor in an autonomous, cross-functional agile squad, in close collaboration with other squads and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with other squads, engineering managers and product managers to identify and solve challenging problems, to successfully scale our automation and new platform capabilities.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 5+ years of working experience as a Backend Engineer working with Java. Additional tools and technologies such as gRPC, GCP, BigQuery and Bigtable are a plus.
* You have strong computer science fundamentals and previous experience building complex backend services at scale.
* You have experience in designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native software components on providers such as GCP, AWS, etc.
* You have experience working directly with stakeholders to understand, document and develop APIs and systems to meet their requirements.
* You are comfortable working collaboratively on cross-functional teams and independently driving complex delivery initiatives.
* You have written distributed, high-volume services and know how to deploy and operate them in production.
* You have a growth mindset and are passionate about your work, striving towards the team’s goals and, ultimately, the Spotify Mission.
* Nice-to-haves: Experience modelling, building and operating integrations with external CMS solutions or working with ML teams for recommendations and data pipelines.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Fullstackutvecklare
description:
*Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens bolåneerbjudande? Vi söker en senior fullstackutvecklare med ett tydligt fokus på frontend, där du blir en nyckelperson i utvecklingen av Skandiabankens digitala kundupplevelse på webben.*
**Att jobba som fullstackutvecklare**
 Som fullstackutvecklare inom teamet Låneansökan blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med bankens bolån.
   

  

 Med ett tydligt fokus på React får du utveckla Skandiabankens digitala kundupplevelse på webben. Rollen ger dig ett brett ansvar med möjlighet att påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval och hur våra lösningar utvecklas över tid.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära product owner, UX och övriga utvecklare och testare. Rollen ger dig en helhetsförståelse för teamets lösningar och hur de samverkar med andra system i bankens IT-landskap.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett team med hög teknisk kompetens där kunskapsdelning, samarbete och inflytande över arbetssätt är en självklar del av vardagen.
   

  

**Du Kommer Bland Annat Att**
* utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar inom bolåneområdet
* ta ägarskap för teamets applikationer och deras integrationer
* påverka arkitektur och tekniska vägval
* bidra till hög kodkvalitet genom kontinuerliga förbättringar och minskad teknisk skuld
* utforska och bidra till hur AI kan användas för att skapa bättre lösningar för både kunder och utvecklare


**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Du är en erfaren utvecklare som drivs av att lösa komplexa problem och omsätta affärsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar. Du har ett genuint intresse för frontendutveckling och motiveras av att skapa moderna, användarvänliga lösningar med hög kvalitet. Du kan dessutom kommunicera tekniska resonemang på ett tydligt sätt med både utvecklare och andra intressenter.
   

  

 Du trivs i en miljö där kunskapsdelning är en självklar del av vardagen och där du gärna coachar och stöttar andra utvecklare. Samarbete är viktigt för dig och du tror på laget före jaget.
   

  

 Som person är du självgående, kommunikativ och prestigelös, med en stark vilja att kontinuerligt förbättra både teknik och arbetssätt. Du uppskattar att arbeta i ett agilt team där dialog, nyfikenhet och samarbete är avgörande för att lyckas.
   

  

**Du Har Flerårig Erfarenhet Av**
* React och TypeScript
* C#, ASP.NET Core/.NET och Microsoft SQL Server
* REST, WCF och Azure DevOps
* Enhetstester och automatiserade tester


**Vad händer nu?**
 Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Stefan Ravelius på stefan.ravelius@skandia.se
   

  

 Om du har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner, Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se
   

  

 Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
**Mer om IT**
 Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsamamans är vårt motto!
   

  

 Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.
   

  

 Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.
   

  

  

  

**Mer om Banken**
 Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.
   

  

 Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

**Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar**
* Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.


 Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

title: Senior Javascript Engineer - Core Experience
description:

 **Senior JavaScript Engineer** 
 to join in on our mission to deliver the greatest igaming experience to our customers. As a part of our multinational frontend team, you would be an important cog in the machinery, creating new features for and maintaining the full product of LeoVegas.com.
 



  





 In close collaboration with product managers, designers and our backend peers, we get to work with a broad variety of initiatives, you will be a key factor delivering features and maintaining our brand. With focus on our so-called RoW (Rest of the world) cluster, you will directly act on markets such as Canada, Germany, Malta and some others, with the possibility to bring your own experience close to the current team, and stakeholders.
 



  





  





**YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:** 



* Develop and maintain high-quality JavaScript applications
* Ensure a smooth and engaging user experience
* You will be responsible for driving the development of most of the frontend features of Leovegas.com
* Improve and maintain the applications with a product focus
* Contribute to launching new brands and brand expansions into new territories



  





  





**OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:** 




  





**Essential Skills:** 



* Strong, proven experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js
* Solid working knowledge of GraphQl
* Practical experience with Node.js and microservices



  





**Nice To Have:** 



* Experience with tracking and monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog)
* Familiarity with OpenAPI and BigQuery
* Experience leveraging AI tools like Claude or GitHub Copilot, alongside a strong curiosity for using AI to elevate engineering practices
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for adopting AI to enhance engineering practices and software delivery



  





  





**WHO WE ARE:** 




 At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
 



  





  





**BENEFITS:** 



* Hybrid work policy
* 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
* 30 annual vacation days
* Occupational Pension
* 5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
* Parental Leave Top-Up
* Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
* 1,500 SEK equipment allowance
* Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts



  





  





**JOIN US!** 




 In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
 



 Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!
 



  





 As our company's working language is English, we’d like to see your
 **CV in English** 
 , please.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About the company
 



 A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. title: Sr. Fullstack Engineer – Frontend | Content Experience
description:
At TV4, technology, innovation, news journalism, sports and entertainment come together.
   

  

 Every week, around eight million people use TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo. How users find, discover and engage with content is central to the overall experience, from the first search to the next recommendation.
   

  

 We are now looking for a
 **Sr Fullstack Engineer with a frontend focus** 
 to join Content Experience, the area responsible for helping people find the right content, at the right time, on the right platform.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 Content Experience is the part of TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo that users interact with when looking for something to watch. A large and constantly changing catalogue of content needs to be easy to discover, navigate and choose from.
   

  

 The experience needs to be fast and intuitive for millions of users across different screens and platforms. This places high demands on both the technical solutions and our understanding of how people actually use our products.
   

  

 You will work close to the actual user experience and solve technically complex problems where the result of what you build is directly visible to the user.
   

  

**Why you might want to join us**
 You want to work closely with product and design and like seeing a clear connection between technical decisions and what actually reaches the user.
   

  

 Your technical strength is in frontend, but you see yourself as a software engineer rather than a specialist in one particular part of the stack. You are comfortable moving across the stack when the problem requires it and want to understand the systems behind the experience you are building.
   

  

 You enjoy combining technical depth with product understanding and taking responsibility from idea and hypothesis through implementation, follow up and continued development.
   

  

 You see AI as a natural part of modern software development and are curious about how new tools and ways of working can help you and the team build better products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Content Experience is a cross functional team where engineering works closely with product and design. We also collaborate with other engineering teams to connect our solutions with the rest of TV4's technical platform.
   

  

 The team has significant technical ownership and is responsible for its solutions all the way to production. The work is characterised by a high degree of autonomy and a close connection between technical decisions, product and users.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and evolve user experiences in React and TypeScript
* Take technical responsibility for frontend architecture, quality, performance and long term sustainability
* Work across the stack, from client and APIs to backend services when the problem requires it
* Build solutions that help users discover, navigate and choose content
* Drive technical initiatives and contribute to architecture and technology decisions
* Turn user needs into working technical solutions together with product and design
* Use AI tools as a natural part of the development process


**About You**
 You are an experienced fullstack engineer with a clear focus on modern frontend development and mature engineering judgement. You can move from a user problem to a technical solution, understand what actually needs to be solved and make well founded technical decisions even when the problem is not fully defined.
   

  

 We believe you:
   

  

* Have deep experience with React, TypeScript and modern web development
* Are comfortable with backend development, APIs and integrations
* Have a strong understanding of frontend architecture, performance, quality and long term sustainability
* Have experience working in modern cloud based product environments
* Understand how frontend applications interact with underlying services and systems
* Can move between the bigger picture and technical detail
* Communicate clearly and work well in a cross functional product team


 It is a plus if you have experience with:
   

  

* React Native
* Go
* GraphQL
* Streaming or media platforms
* Search, recommendation systems or personalised user experiences
* High traffic consumer products

**Backend:** 
 Go, Node.js
   

  

**Frontend:** 
 React, React Native, TypeScript
   

  

**Cloud:** 
 AWS
   

  

**Databases:** 
 PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
   

  

**DevOps & Observability:** 
 GitHub Actions, Terraform, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
   

  

**AI & Developer Tooling:** 
 Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, CLI/MCP integrations
   

  

**Productivity:** 
 Linear, Notion, Slack
   

  

**What TV4 Offers**
* Short paths from idea to decision in a senior technology organisation with high autonomy for both teams and individuals
* The opportunity to influence how millions of users find and discover content
* A culture that values sustainable technical solutions over quick fixes
* Colleagues with strong technical expertise and a high degree of ownership
* The ability to properly disconnect after work. We have dedicated on call arrangements with voluntary participation and do not expect you to be available outside working hours
* A modern office with gym, restaurant, parking garage and rooftop terrace

title: Design Engineer
description:
Validio is the agentic data management platform that automates data quality, lineage, and cataloging — so enterprises can finally trust the data behind their analytics, AI, and reporting. As a Design Engineer on our frontend team, you shape our core user experience — working closely with our Lead Frontend Engineer and Head of Product.
 



  





 We don't have a separate design team; the product's experience is designed by the people who build it. AI tools now handle much of the repetitive boilerplate, so the job has shifted to what we should build and how it should behave. Because generating code is easy, the bar for good architecture, code quality, and maintainability is higher than ever — we don't blindly ship AI output. Your role centers on product judgment, engineering discipline, and translating complex user needs into an interface that feels fast and lightweight.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Evolve our high-scale lineage graph — often tens of thousands of nodes per customer — so rendering, querying, and exploration stay fast and responsive
* Own the data quality experience: the density, layouts, and metric graphs that keep thousands of concurrent checks against completeness, validity, timeliness, accuracy, consistency, and uniqueness clean and quick to scan
* Turn incident response — deciding if an anomaly is real, finding the cause, checking sample rows, re-running validators, tracing lineage upstream — into one coherent workflow
* Make alerting configuration simple enough to hold in your head across Slack, Teams, Jira, email, ServiceNow, and webhooks, so the alerts that matter don't get buried in noise



  





**What you'll bring** 



* Strong product sense — you notice typography, spacing, hierarchy, and motion, and care about how a product feels to use
* A preference for the web platform — strong TypeScript and DOM fundamentals, and a clear-eyed view of framework trade-offs
* Strong SQL — performant queries against large datasets, reading execution plans, and reasoning about query cost
* Critical use of AI tools — you move fast with modern LLMs but retain full ownership of the architecture and catch what they get wrong
* A generalist mindset — comfortable across the UI, the GraphQL API, and the data layers underneath to ship a feature end to end



  





**What we don't look for** 



* Years of experience as a metric — we measure seniority by shipped work, architectural judgment, and product taste
* Strict specialization — we're looking for builders who want to own features from idea to production, not people who only want to write CSS or only design backend schemas



  





**Our stack, and why** 




 TypeScript and native Web Components on the frontend — no React, no Vue. We stay close to the web platform to avoid framework churn and major migration cycles. Node.js and GraphQL on the backend, on Postgres with the TimescaleDB extension for time-series workloads — we keep tight control over our data shapes to eliminate unnecessary latency. Claude Code is in daily use, and we adapt our engineering loop as the tooling evolves; we aim for one production release per sprint, weekly or bi-weekly. Prior experience with Web Components isn't required — solid TypeScript and DOM fundamentals are what matter.
 



  





**Why Validio** 




 Founded in Sweden in 2019, we're trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, Truecaller, Traveloka, and Deutsche Glasfaser. We raised a $30M Series A this year and grew ARR 800% in twelve months as enterprises got serious about making their data AI-ready. At around 25 people, you'll decide what the core experience should be, not just how it gets built.
 



  





 Come as you are. We hire for what you'll build with us, and we welcome applicants of every background.

 Primärt kommer du arbeta med realtidsintegrationer genom API lösningar i vår tekniska plattform där MuleSoft Anypoint idag är grunden. Vi organiserar oss genom SAFe ramverket och vår utvecklingsmiljö omfattar bland annat Java, Red Hat OpenShift, Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, Informatica och Spring Boot.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet till ständig utveckling och lärande i arbetet. Vi jobbar aktivt med kompetens- och teknikutveckling genom exempelvis innovationssprintar. * ha förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker, vara flexibel och öppen för förändringar

* vara målfokuserad och bidra till att syftet med verksamheten uppnås

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, fördelarna med att jobba hos oss och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.

**AI & Business Systems Specialist till Medlink** 




 Vill du använda AI, kod och automation för att lösa verkliga problem – och se lösningarna göra skillnad direkt i verksamheten?
 



  





 Medlink söker en tekniskt nyfiken och verksamhetsnära person som vill utveckla våra system, automatisera manuellt arbete och skapa bättre beslutsunderlag. Du kommer även att bidra inom digital leadsgenerering och andra initiativ där teknik, data och marknad möts.

**Om rollen** 




 Som AI & Business Systems Specialist får du en bred roll i gränslandet mellan teknik och verksamhet. Du arbetar nära organisationen, sätter dig in i våra processer och identifierar hur teknik kan förenkla och förbättra. En viktig del av rollen är att själv kunna utveckla och implementera lösningar.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* bygga interna applikationer, AI-agenter och automatiserade arbetsflöden
* snabbt utveckla prototyper och omsätta fungerande idéer i praktiken
* konfigurera och vidareutveckla CRM och andra affärssystem
* bygga integrationer mellan system genom API:er och webhooks
* utveckla dashboards, rapporter och KPI:er
* analysera data med SQL och bidra till god datakvalitet
* automatisera rapportering och uppföljning
* bidra till digital leadsgenerering och analys av digitala kampanjer
* förbättra hur leads kommer in i och bearbetas i våra system



  





 Marknadsföring är ett kompletterande ansvarsområde. Rollens huvudsakliga fokus ligger på teknik, system, automation och data.
 



  





**Vem söker vi?** 




 Du har relevant erfarenhet eller på annat sätt förvärvad kompetens inom exempelvis systemutveckling, affärssystem, automation, dataanalys eller ett närliggande område.
 



  





 Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Det viktigaste är att du har en god teknisk grund, lär dig snabbt och tycker om att själv ta reda på hur saker kan lösas.
 



  





 Vi tror att du:
 


* har erfarenhet av programmering och kan bygga enklare applikationer eller tekniska lösningar
* har arbetat med, eller har ett stort intresse för, AI-baserade utvecklingsverktyg
* förstår hur system kan kopplas samman genom API:er, webhooks eller andra integrationer
* har erfarenhet av SQL, dataanalys eller BI
* kan förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem i praktiska lösningar
* är självgående, lösningsorienterad och prestigelös



  





 Erfarenhet av CRM-system, automatiseringsplattformar, digital annonsering eller leadsgenerering är meriterande. Du behöver däremot inte vara specialist inom samtliga områden.
 



  





**Om Medlink** 




 Medlink arbetar med bemanning inom vården och har sedan 2014 hjälpt vårdgivare att hitta rätt kompetens. Vi befinner oss i en utvecklingsfas där teknik, AI och datadrivna arbetssätt får en allt viktigare roll.
 



  





 Hos oss får du arbeta nära verksamheten, med kort väg från idé till beslut. Du får stort utrymme att påverka både våra arbetssätt och tekniska vägval.
 



  





 Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor på Röntgenvägen 3C i Solna, nära Karolinska.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Messaging Platform
description:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.
   

  

 The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.
   

  

 We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design, build, and ship machine learning models that optimize messaging across push, email, and in-app channels
* Plan and run A/B experiments in a multi-objective environment, balancing conversion, engagement, retention, and reachability
* Contribute to reinforcement learning systems that optimize for long-term user outcomes rather than immediate interactions
* Partner with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to define what success looks like and how to measure it
* Own the full ML lifecycle, from data and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and iteration
* Integrate ML models with upstream systems, including domain value signals and opportunity generation frameworks
* Help shape the future of AI-assisted development within the team, exploring how tools can accelerate experimentation and delivery


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production environments at scale
* You are comfortable translating business problems into ML solutions and discussing trade-offs with cross-functional partners
* You have worked on complex optimization problems such as ranking systems or multi-objective decision-making
* You bring hands-on experience with PyTorch and distributed systems such as Ray or similar frameworks
* You understand experimentation deeply and can design reliable tests in environments with interacting metrics
* You are able to analyze results using approaches like causal inference or metric decomposition when needed
* You have experience with or curiosity about reinforcement learning and long-term optimization systems
* You enjoy working across disciplines and navigating ambiguity while shaping strategy and direction


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London and Stockholm
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**HAYPP GROUP**
 We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1,1 billion smokers in the world. Around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering people other nicotine products online.
   

  

 Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands, present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com, Nicokick.com etc., we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish style snus online as well as disposable vapes. With our headquarters located on Östgötagatan in Stockholm we are 300 team members mainly but not exclusively based in Sweden. Also, we are an innovative and fast-moving company that is growing rapidly, driving sustainable business and are changing the world in the process. We are currently on an exciting expansion journey, converting more and more smokers to smoke-free alternatives across all our markets globally.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help shape the future of data at Haypp Group. As part of our Data Engineering team, you'll play a key role in building and scaling the data platform that powers decision-making across the entire business.
   

  

 Working with a modern AWS-based stack including Redshift, dbt, Airflow, Docker and Terraform, you'll design and develop robust data solutions that transform complex e-commerce data into actionable insights. Your work will enable everything from business-critical analytics to advanced machine learning initiatives, helping us make smarter decisions at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 As a Senior Data Engineer in Haypp, you’ll find modern technologies, agile workflows, and tight integration at the heart of the business. Implement, develop, and maintain data pipelines connecting to multiple data sources such as in-house e-comm platform, shipping providers, warehouse systems etc.
   

  

 You will be working with the following things daily:
   

  

* Build and maintain scalable, testable and reliable data pipelines using best practices.
* Build and main robust data infrastructure in a version-controlled way
* Work closely with Analytics team colleagues to ensure integrity and quality of data.
* Liaise with stakeholders from all parts of the organisation to develop the data infrastructure to meet the prioritised business projects.
* Together with the tech team, drive the data infrastructure and its architecture forward.
* Learn, grow, be challenged and have fun!


**What We Want From You**
 Technical skills are important, but so is the way we work together. We're looking for someone who enjoys collaborating across teams, sharing ideas, and contributing to an open and supportive culture.
   

  

* Previous experience in Data Engineering roles.
* Fluency in using SQL and Python is a must to succeed at this role.
* A strong understanding on data governance, security, maintainability and observability.
* Experience working in and managing a cloud environment, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* Experience modeling data using industry standard tools such as dbt, and with data modeling concepts such as star schema, dimensional modeling etc.
* A commitment to ensuring data quality for downstream users of data.
* Technical ownership and familiarity with agile ways of working.
* You have a technical and commercial mindset, meaning you can take a business request and implement it technically.
* Are a team player – needs to be able to interact with the team, be adaptable.
* A good communicator, both with technical and non-technical counterparts.
* Fluent in English. Swedish is not a requirement but can be a plus.
* Ambitious with a will to learn and develop.


**What We Offer**
 We are a value driven company with our values
 *We team up* 
 ,
 *Innovation Drives Us* 
 ,
 *Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy* 
 and
 *Going the Extra Mile* 
 at the heartbeat of everything that we do. With us you can always expect to get help from people who want to achieve things together and to be able to speak your mind in every social constellation you are part of. We highly value all ideas no matter where they come from, and we are not afraid to try new things out. We are also welcoming, inclusive and everyone at Haypp Group has a voice. In addition, we seize opportunities by putting in hands-on, hard work and celebrating when we reach our goals. With us, you should always feel safe, appreciated and valued but at the same time challenged and excited.
   

  

 Because we recognize that our team members are our most important differentiator, we offer our team members generous benefits. We offer the following perks to everyone at Haypp Group:
   

  

* Competitive occupational pension
* Insurance plan, including private healthcare
* 30 days of paid vacation
* Parental pay lift
* Wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK per year
* Lots of social happenings


**SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY!**
 If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, let us know you’re interested by submitting your application!
   

  

 Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity, and we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, and marital status. We want to offer you great recruitment experience, and if there is anything we can do to make you more comfortable in the process with us, please let us know.

With origins in Scandinavia our extensive experience from pioneering markets in smoke free alternatives, as well as being a leader in the e-commerce sector, we now fully bring our vision to a global scale.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Energy Optimization
description:
Residential heating is one of Europe’s largest sources of CO₂ emissions, while energy prices remain unpredictable for many households. At Aira, we’re on a mission to change that. Founded in 2022 and now employing more than 800 people, we develop and install clean energy solutions—including heat pumps, solar panels, and battery systems—powered by intelligent technology that helps homes operate more efficiently.
   

  

 Our goal is simple: to help households reduce both their carbon footprint and their energy costs.
   

  

 With headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Poland, and hubs across the UK, Germany, and Italy, Aira is rapidly scaling to bring clean energy technology to 5 million homes by 2034.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In the Energy Optimization team, we build optimization and machine learning systems that help control when heat pumps run, when batteries charge or discharge, and when it makes sense to export energy to the grid. We are also building new flexibility capabilities by coordinating fleets of homes to support the grid when it matters most.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join this product team. You’ll work on models and systems that turn messy real-world signals into reliable decisions for customers’ homes. This includes building and improving forecasting and optimization models, productionising them, monitoring their performance, and iterating based on real-world outcomes.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other teams to ship customer-facing intelligence that is reliable, understandable, and valuable. We value clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
   

  

 If you enjoy turning ML models into production systems that create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Build and improve ML and optimization models that power customer-facing energy optimization features.
* Work on time-series forecasting, scheduling, and decision models for heat pumps, batteries, solar, tariffs, weather, and customer behaviour.
* Productionise and own models end-to-end, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and iteration based on real-world outcomes.
* Run experiments on real customer systems, evaluate impact, and turn results into product decisions.
* Contribute to initiatives from discovery to production impact, helping define success metrics and align with stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, model behaviour, and what is good enough to ship.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Experience building ML, data, or optimization systems that are used in real-world products.
* Good programming skills in Python and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience taking models beyond notebooks, including evaluation, testing, deployment, or monitoring.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.
* A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset: you care about measurable customer impact, not model complexity for its own sake.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.


**Bonus points if you have**
* Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.
* Experience with constrained optimization, control systems, or physical systems modelling.


**What is in it for you?**
* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: Master Thesis: Cast PyTorch to RTL
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Deploying neural networks on real-time or embedded hardware (FPGA/ASIC) today often means doing manual RTL translation, wiring up weight memories, and tuning parallelism to fit DSP budgets — work that can take days to weeks per model. Existing HLS tools (e.g., Vitis HLS, Intel HLS) focus on C/C++ rather than trained checkpoints, and neural network compilers (e.g., TVM, ONNX Runtime) target software runtimes instead of parameterized RTL for different FPGA targets.
   

  

 This thesis closes the power-efficiency and productivity gap by creating an automated tool chain that converts PyTorch/AI models into synthesizable RTL for FPGA/ASIC. You will build on an existing foundation codebase to broaden model and layer support and deliver an end-to-end flow from model to hardware. You will work at the intersection of AI, digital design, and EDA tooling; deliver real hardware acceleration results with measurable impact; collaborate with experienced researchers and hardware engineers; and contribute to a tool that can drastically reduce time-to-hardware.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Develop a tool chain that takes PyTorch models — trained (.pth/.pt) or untrained (.py) — and automatically generates:
+ A complete, synthesizable SystemVerilog implementation
+ A synthesis planning report
+ An RTL hierarchy file
+ A ready-to-build FPGA/ASIC project

* Investigate and compare current research on AI-to-RTL conversion methods
* Understand our approach and improve its underlying theories
* Continue developing the tool chain from the base code to support as many models and layer types as possible
* Use the tool chain to convert a real model and deploy it on an FPGA to test function and performance
* Conclude with a result presentation for the Ericsson Research team


**The skills you bring:**
* Master’s studies in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar
* Background in AI models and RTL code development
* Familiarity with PyTorch, digital design (SystemVerilog/Verilog/VHDL), and FPGA tool flows (e.g., Xilinx/AMD, Intel) is meriting
* Understanding of HLS, compilers, or hardware/software co-design is a plus


**Why join Ericsson?**
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Master Thesis: ASIC FPGA code converting
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 ASIC and FPGA development both use RTL as the design source. However, implementation relies on different hard IPs and primitives that vary not only between ASIC and FPGA, but also across vendors. These differences mean RTL cannot be directly reused across targets even if the syntax is the same. This thesis addresses that gap by developing a conversion toolchain that automatically maps primitives and IP instantiations and handles vendor-specific differences, enabling RTL reuse between ASIC and FPGA flows.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Develop a Python-based toolchain (with a simple GUI) to convert ASIC RTL to FPGA RTL and vice versa
* Automatically replace primitives and IP instantiations during conversion, accounting for vendor-specific constructs
* Investigate and compare current research and methods for RTL conversion
* Identify major implementation/synthesis tool vendors (e.g., Synopsys, AMD/Xilinx, Cadence, Intel) and document key differences relevant to conversion
* Use the developed toolchain to convert an example ASIC design to FPGA RTL and run place-and-route to closure (no errors)
* Conclude with a results presentation to the Ericsson Research team


**The skills you bring:**
* Master’s studies in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar
* Background in Python and RTL code development
* Familiarity with digital design (SystemVerilog/Verilog/VHDL), FPGA/ASIC flows, and vendor tools (e.g., Synopsys, Cadence, AMD/Xilinx, Intel) is meriting
* Understanding of EDA tool differences and IP/primitives mapping is a plus


**Why join Ericsson?**

title: RedHat OpenShift Engineer
description:
This is a job description for a Red Hat OpenShift Architect with proven experience migrating workloads from VMware (vSphere/onprem VMs) to Red Hat OpenShift (Kubernetes). The role focuses on solution architecture, migration planning and execution, platform automation, and ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available OpenShift-based platforms.
 



  





**Role Overview** 



* Lead architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise OpenShift platforms.
* Execute migration strategies for moving applications and data from VMware virtual machines and traditional architectures to containerized OpenShift environments.
* Work with cross-functional teams (Dev, Security, Networking, Storage) to deliver migration projects with minimal disruption and measurable business value.



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Experience in end-to-end OpenShift platform architectures (high-availability, multi-AZ, multi-cluster, hybrid cloud).
* Create migration strategies (lift-and-shift, replatform, refactor) for VMware-hosted workloads to OpenShift, including phased migration plans and cutover/rollback procedures.
* Lead proofs-of-concept (PoCs), pilot migrations, and production migrations; validate performance, resilience, and security post-migration.
* Build automation for platform provisioning and day‑2 operations using Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform, OpenShift Ansible/Installer, Operators).
* Define networking, storage, and security models for OpenShift (CNI selection, persistent storage via CSI, RBAC, network policies, service mesh considerations).
* Integrate CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (e.g., Jenkins/GitLab/ArgoCD) for automated app delivery to OpenShift.
* Establish observability and logging (Prometheus, Grafana, EFK/OLM) and implement backup/restore strategies (Velero or equivalent).
* Collaborate with VMware/vSphere teams to assess virtualization inventories, dependencies, and create migration timelines.
* Produce architecture artifacts: diagrams, runbooks, migration playbooks, capacity and cost estimates, and operational runbooks for SRE teams.
* Mentor engineering teams on containerization best practices, operator patterns, and cloud-native application design.
* Ensure compliance with security, governance, and regulatory requirements during and after migration.



**Required Qualifications & Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in enterprise infrastructure/cloud roles, with at least 3–5 years specifically designing and operating Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes platforms.
* Hands-on experience migrating applications and services from VMware/vSphere (on-prem) to OpenShift/Kubernetes.
* Strong knowledge of VMware stack: vSphere, vCenter, and familiarity with virtualization concepts, VM inventories, and dependency mapping.
* Expertise in OpenShift installation and configuration (IPI/UPI), cluster lifecycle, and operator model.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, OpenShift CLI/oc).
* Solid understanding of networking (CNI plugins, load balancing, DNS), persistent storage and CSI drivers, and storage backends (NFS, Ceph/Rook, SAN).
* Experience with CI/CD and GitOps integration for container deployments.
* Familiar with backup, migration, and application portability tools (e.g., Velero, Red Hat Migrations/operand tools, image registries).
* Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python) and familiarity with container tooling (Docker, Podman).
* Experience defining security posture for Kubernetes/OpenShift (RBAC, OPA/Gatekeeper, secrets management).
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.



**Preferred / Nice-to-have** 



* Red Hat certifications: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration, RHCE, or RHCA.
* Experience with data migration for stateful applications and databases.
* Prior experience running large-scale multi-cluster OpenShift environments and hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute).



**Success Metrics / KPIs** 



* Percentage of workloads successfully migrated within planned windows and with minimal downtime.
* Number of migrations completed per quarter and time-to-migration per application class.
* Post-migration application performance and availability compared to pre-migration baselines.
* Reduction in infrastructure cost or operational overhead after migration.
* Automation coverage for provisioning and day‑2 operations (percentage automated tasks).
* Number of runbooks and documentation items completed and validated by operations teams.



**Deliverables** 



* Migration strategy document and phased migration roadmap.
* Architecture diagrams and sizing/capacity plans.
* Migration playbooks, cutover and rollback procedures.
* Automated deployment scripts and IaC modules.
* Operational runbooks for monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Post-migration validation and performance reports.

title: DevOps & Automation Engineer
description:
**DevOps & Automation Engineer – GE ADMS Series 6**
 Göteborg/Malmø, Sweden
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a DevOps & Automation Engineer, you will make an impact by designing, building, and maintaining the CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation capabilities that underpin one of the most technically ambitious GE ADMS Series 6 programs in Europe. You will be a valued member of our Energy & Utilities Technology team and work collaboratively with software engineers, GE ADMS architects, utility stakeholders, and cloud infrastructure specialists to accelerate delivery speed, raise quality standards, and build a resilient automation backbone for critical grid operations technology.
   

  

 Whether you're an experienced DevOps engineer ready to take ownership of end-to-end pipeline architecture, or an earlier-career professional with approximately two years of solid hands-on experience, we want to hear from you. This program spans live GE ADMS Series 6 implementations, platform upgrades, and a large-scale multi-company data migration — making it a genuinely impactful place to grow your career in the energy technology space.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, implement, and continuously maintain robust Jenkins pipelines for continuous integration and delivery across the GE ADMS Series 6 program.
* Automate build, test, and deployment processes to increase release frequency, reduce manual effort, and improve overall delivery quality.
* Use Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP — ensuring consistency, scalability, and infrastructure-as-code best practices.
* Implement and maintain Ansible playbooks for server provisioning, application configuration management, and environment standardization.
* Develop Python scripts and custom automation tooling to streamline operational and deployment tasks across the program.
* Manage artifact repositories and actively support release management processes, including versioning, deployment tracking, and rollback strategies.
* Administer GitHub repositories — including pull request workflows, branching strategies, and code integration processes — ensuring clean, governed delivery pipelines.
* Collaborate with utility stakeholders, ADMS engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate operational requirements into automated, scalable solutions.
* Coordinate with network and cybersecurity teams to ensure secure infrastructure connectivity and compliance with relevant standards.


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 1The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.2
   

  

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, software engineering, infrastructure automation, or a related field — candidates with approximately 2 years of highly relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Proven, hands-on experience designing and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, including pipeline-as-code practices.
* Practical proficiency with Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning and management across one or more of AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Working experience with Ansible for configuration management, server provisioning, and application automation.
* Strong Python scripting skills applied to automation, tooling development, or deployment workflow optimization.
* Solid understanding of GitHub workflows, branching strategies, pull request management, and collaborative code integration practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in hybrid, distributed team environments.


**These Will Help You Stand Out**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Applied knowledge of DevOps security best practices, including secrets management, pipeline hardening, and infrastructure compliance scanning.
* Familiarity with additional configuration management tools such as Chef.
* Exposure to microservices architecture and its operational implications for CI/CD and infrastructure management.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including sprint-based workflows, backlog management, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Any understanding of GE ADMS systems and architecture is an advantage — though not a requirement, your curiosity about the energy sector is very much welcome.
* Background in utilities, energy management, smart grid technologies, or critical infrastructure environments.


 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Technical Owner – ITSM Platform (Halo)
description:
Do you want to take end-to-end technical ownership of a business-critical platform and shape how IT Service Management works across Schibsted?
   

  

 We are looking for a Technical Owner for our ITSM platform, Halo . In this role, you will
 ***combine platform ownership, solution architecture and hands-on technical expertise***
 . You will be responsible for the technical direction of Halo, its integrations and automation, while ensuring that the platform remains secure, compliant, reliable and fit for the needs of our users.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and implementation: defining
 **what** 
 needs to change, deciding
 **how** 
 it should be implemented, and working hands-on
 **when** 
 needed to make it happen.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform ownership & roadmap – Own the technical strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and governance for Halo, including vendor relationships, KPIs and SLAs (towards external supplier, 2nd and 3rd line support).
* Architecture & technical design – Translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions.
* Platform configuration & development – Configure and continuously improve Halo, including workflows, automation, scripting, dashboards, reporting, platform customisation and runbooks.
* Integrations & APIs – Reviews and maintains integration designs and changes, maintains visibility of integration dependencies, governs API access, authentication and permissions.
* Operations & lifecycle management – Own upgrades, testing, troubleshooting, data migrations, licence management (for development, test & production environments) and support, including major incidents and technical escalations for Halo, API and 3rd party connections.
* Security & compliance – Ensure appropriate access management, audit logging, data retention and other platform controls, with accountability for the platform's security and compliance.


**Who are we looking for?**
 You have experience owning and managing enterprise SaaS platforms and are comfortable combining
 **technical ownership, strategic roadmap, architecture and hands-on implementation** 
 .
   

  

 You are comfortable moving between strategic and hands-on work. One day you might discuss roadmap priorities or solution architecture; the next you might improve a workflow or troubleshoot an operational issue.

title: Integration & Technical Delivery Specialist
description:
**Job Description: Integration & Technical Delivery Specialist** 

  






 At Sesamy we’re building a smart platform and APIs that empower publishers, creators, and media companies to monetize digital content seamlessly. Our central headquarters and office are located at Skeppargatan 65 in Stockholm, where our team collaborates to build flexible, high-performing digital ecosystem solutions.
 




  






 When a partner integrates Sesamy's products, someone has to turn scoping conversations and API documentation into something that actually goes live — and stays working. That’s you. You'll work hands-on across the full implementation lifecycle, from scoping and solution alignment through go-live and beyond, running multiple concurrent partner implementations at once.
 




  






 Acting as a vital bridge between tech and business, you translate technical capabilities into commercial value and bring business needs into engineering discussions. You’ll be the person partners call when something breaks — troubleshooting technical issues in real time, guiding them through APIs and digital content workflows, and maintaining complete ownership over our technical documentation so it stays clear, accurate, and continuously updated as our platform evolves. You’ll also leverage AI tools to move faster through that work, driving real efficiency across the team.
 




  






 You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations to define integration scope, set delivery priorities, and ensure that everything meets Sesamy’s high standards for quality and user experience. Because you’ll understand partner systems, digital publishing platforms, you’ll feed your insights back into how Sesamy builds — improving our products, integration frameworks, and developer experience.
 




  




**What you'll do**
* **Lead Integrations:** 

 Run multiple concurrent partner implementations from scoping and solution alignment all the way through to go-live.
* **Bridge Tech & Business:** 

 Translate complex technical solutions into clear business outcomes for commercial teams, while advocating for partner and market needs in discussions with Engineering and Product.
* **Own Technical Documentation:** 

 Take end-to-end ownership of our developer documentation, API guides, and integration specs—ensuring they are continuously updated, easy to follow, and reflect the latest platform updates.
* **Troubleshoot & Guide:** 

 Solve technical issues in real time and guide partners through APIs, webhooks, digital content distribution, and subscription management workflows.
* **Drive Efficiency with AI:** 

 Use AI tools to accelerate delivery work, improve internal workflows, and push for their adoption across the team.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally:** 

 Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams to define integration scope, align delivery priorities, and uphold Sesamy’s high quality bar.
* **Feedback & Continuous Improvement:** 

 Turn insights gained from partner systems and integration challenges into actionable feedback to enhance Sesamy’s products and developer frameworks.



  




**Who You Are**
* **Experience:** 

 You have 3+ years of experience in technical program/delivery management, partner-led implementations, or complex integration delivery — ideally within digital content, media tech, ad agency or SaaS ecosystems.
* **Technical Depth & Ownership:** 

 You understand APIs, webhooks, and system architectures well enough to troubleshoot issues yourself and take pride in keeping technical documentation spotless and up to date.
* **Tech-to-Business Communicator:** 

 You move comfortably between deep technical discussions with engineering teams and strategic commercial conversations with partners and executive stakeholders.
* **AI-Minded:** 

 You actively use AI tools to speed up delivery, improve docs, or streamline processes, encouraging your teammates to do the same.
* **Domain Knowledge:** 

 You know your way around SaaS, digital publishing, subscription models, or digital asset workflows.
* **Payments Experience:** 

 It's a plus if you have experience working with payments or payment systems.
* **Self-Driven & Accountable:** 

 You naturally take ownership, drive implementations forward without waiting for directions, and hold yourself and your work to a high standard.
