title: Manufacturing Quality Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


We are seeking a highly motivated Manufacturing Quality Engineer to join our Supply Chain organization in Uppsala. This is a key role combining manufacturing engineering, quality engineering, compliance, and continuous improvement responsibilities within a regulated medical technology environment.  

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership to production teams, drive quality and process improvements, ensure regulatory compliance, and support the successful introduction and sustainment of manufacturing processes, equipment, and products. The role offers broad exposure across manufacturing, quality assurance, validation, audits, CAPA management.  

This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, driving improvements, leading quality initiatives, and collaborating across functions to deliver safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing operations.**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manufacturing & Process Improvement**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on product quality, process performance, productivity, and cost efficiency.
* Identify manufacturing challenges, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide daily technical support to production teams regarding manufacturing methods, tooling, equipment, processes, and product-related issues.
* Support new product introductions (NPI), design transfers, process validation, equipment implementation, and manufacturing readiness activities.
* Lead and support Lean Manufacturing initiatives to improve flow, efficiency, and operational excellence.

**Quality & Compliance Leadership**

* Serve as the Quality Engineering representative within the Supply Chain organization at the Uppsala site.
* Lead and support investigations related to non-conformances, complaints, CAPAs, and quality events.
* Participate in and support site CAPA Board activities, ensuring timely and effective closure of investigations and actions.
* Maintain compliance with applicable quality systems, regulatory requirements, and industry standards, including ISO 13485, FDA, and internal procedures.

**Audits & Regulatory Support**

* Plan, perform, and support internal quality audits.
* Actively participate in external inspections and audits conducted by regulatory authorities, notified bodies, and customers.
* Ensure effective responses to audit observations and support implementation of corrective actions.

**Validation & Equipment Management**

* Lead and support validation and verification activities for manufacturing processes, equipment, software, and tooling.
* Develop validation plans, execute protocols, analyze data, and document results.

**Safety & Environmental Leadership**

* Promote and support a strong safety culture within manufacturing operations.
* Ensure processes, equipment, and work methods comply with environmental, health, and safety requirements.
* Identify workplace risks and drive corrective actions to maintain a safe and compliant working environment.

**Quality Responsibilities**

* Comply with the GE HealthCare Quality Management System, Quality Policy, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Complete assigned Quality and Compliance training within established timelines.
* Identify, escalate, and address quality and compliance concerns in a timely manner.
* Maintain knowledge of and compliance with requirements related to:
	+ Document Control
	+ Design Transfer
	+ Verification & Validation
	+ Acceptance Activities
	+ Device Master Records (DMR)
	+ Device History Records (DHR)
	+ Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* Experience in manufacturing, quality engineering, process engineering, or a related technical field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple activities.
* Experience working within regulated industries and structured quality systems.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional and international teams.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, root cause analysis, risk management, and continuous improvement methodologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or Business.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated industries.
* Working knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA Quality System Regulations, and GMP requirements.
* Experience in, CAPA investigations, validation activities, and quality improvement projects.
* Certification or experience in Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated success in identifying and implementing best practices.
* Experience working in matrix organizations and managing ambiguity.
* Previous project management or project leadership experience.

**What We Offer**

* A highly visible role with significant influence on manufacturing quality and operational performance.
* Opportunities to lead strategic quality and process improvement initiatives.
* Exposure to advanced manufacturing technologies in a regulated medical technology environment.
* Collaboration with experienced engineering, quality, operations, and regulatory professionals.
* A culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, patient impact, and professional development.

**Additional Information**
==========================

You will be a valued member of our Energy & Utilities Technology team and work collaboratively with utility stakeholders, ADMS architects, infrastructure specialists, and engineering teams to deliver resilient, scalable, and highly available operational technology solutions.
  
This role offers the opportunity to work on some of the most technically complex utility modernization programs in the industry, including new ADMS implementations, platform upgrades, and large-scale system consolidation initiatives. Whether you're an experienced ADMS engineer or a technically strong professional looking to deepen your expertise in utility operations technology, we'd love to hear from you.

We’re on a mission to empower people with disabilities to do what they once did or never thought possible. As the world-leader in assistive communication solutions, we empower our customers to express themselves, connect with the world, and live richer lives.

  

At Tobii Dynavox, you can grow your career within a dynamic, global company that has a clear, impactful purpose - with the flexibility to also do what truly matters to you outside of work. What’s more, you’ll be part of a work culture where collaboration is the norm and individuality is welcomed.

  

As a member of our team, you’ll have the power to innovate for good. You’ll see your ideas in use in new applications, work with the latest technology on leading platforms, and deliver meaningful solutions for our customers.  




  

The Senior Mechanical Engineer is responsible for system level designs and prototype fabrication of the hardware portion on our FDA Class II registered AAC devices. The senior mechanical engineer utilizes a 3D CAD platform (SolidWorks), which includes solid modeling and surface modeling, assembly modeling, and 2D drawing development to meet the program requirements and needs of our device users.

  

The senior mechanical engineer will collaborate with other mechanical engineers, industrial designers, electrical engineers, product managers, project managers, QA/RA, sourcing and suppliers, as well as our manufacturing group in China to ensure program design activities, goals and targets are completed on-time, on budget, to ensure a successful product. A key emphasis is the ability to contribute to a fast-paced development team to bring engineering solutions from concept through production to give our customers a voice utilizing our AAC devices.

  

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

* Conceptual and detailed design of molded components (plastic and metal), sheet metal and machined components.
* Generate parts, assemblies, and drawings using SolidWorks.
* Develop innovative solutions that support the project requirements. Hands on prototyping and proof of concept.
* Work as part of a team of mechanical and manufacturing engineering staff to bring projects through prototyping and into production launch.
* Perform and present gated design reviews with both internal staff and external vendors at specific times in the design life cycle of an AAC device. - Participate in the ECO process and support change management.
* Develop BOMs and part numbers in our QMS system.
* Risk management
 **Who we are looking for**:

**Minimum Education and Experience**


Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering and 5-10+ years relevant work experience developing complex plastic/metal injection molded components that can be tooled and molded. Electronics hardware development experience preferred.

 **Required Skills and Education:**

* Experience with detail part/assembly/drawing development is required
* Experience with design for manufacturability and assembly is required
* Proficient utilizing SolidWorks
* Proficient in complex 3D solid and surface modeling
* All Microsoft Office software and Teams
* Great problem solving and communication skills
* Experience being part of a high-performance team in a fast-paced environment

* Background in FDA registered Class II medical devices
* An understanding of ISO 13485 standards and IEC60601
* Experience with AAC devices

* Plastic injection molding tool development
* Collaborating with a world-wide team (USA, China, Sweden)

Vi söker en **Senior AI Engineer** för ett uppdrag som utförs i **Sverige.**


**Uppdragsbeskrivning:**


Vi söker en senior AI Engineer till ett spännande uppdrag med fokus på att utveckla AI-drivna funktioner i en verksamhetsnära och kvalitetskritisk miljö.


**Ansvarsområden**


* Utveckla AI-funktioner som omvandlar innehåll till användbara förslag i vardagen.
* Designa pipelines, prompt- och kedjestrukturer samt strukturerad output i tydliga, testbara steg.
* Arbeta med modellval och modellstrategi, inklusive finjustering av öppna vikter.
* Bygga upp ett dataunderlag med mätbar kvalitet där data är avidentifierad, versionshanterad och reproducerbar.
* Ta fram mätmetodik per funktion för att definiera felviktning och kvalitetskrav innan implementering.
* Sätta upp regressionstester och löpande kvalitetsuppföljning i produktion.
* Bygga spårbarhet kring AI-förslag och användarens godkännanden eller ändringar för att säkerställa transparens och kontinuerlig förbättring.
* Arbeta nära domänexperter och lämna efter dig förvaltningsbara lösningar.

**Kravprofil**


**Obligatoriska kvalifikationer:**

* Erfarenhet av att ha byggt LLM-baserade system i produktion (ej enbart prototyper).
* Förmåga att konkret beskriva hur du har agerat, itererat och förbättrat lösningar över tid.
* Stark kompetens inom både datamodellering, pipelines och modellnära arbete.
* Förståelse för varför versionshantering av dataset är lika viktig som versionshantering av kod.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med känsliga personuppgifter och komplex avidentifiering.
* Van att arbeta mot tydliga kvalitetskrav snarare än enbart demoeffekt.
* God förståelse för tillförlitlighet i AI-lösningar, särskilt i sammanhang där felaktiga svar kan få stor påverkan.

description:
### **Datacenter Critical Facilities Engineer – HVAC Maintenance Specialist**


* JR-163398
* On Site
* Stockholm
* Operations
* Full time
* 24.7

**Who are we?**


Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.  

  



A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.


Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
**Job Summary**
===============


The Critical Facilities Engineer operates, manages, maintains, and repairs HVAC systems, critical and non-critical power systems, plumbing, fire control and suppression systems, roofing, exterior grounds, and all related vendor-supported activities within a mission-critical data center environment.


A key focus of this role is the safe, reliable, and efficient maintenance of HVAC and cooling infrastructure, including chilled water systems, CRAC/CRAH units, air handling equipment, refrigeration components, pumps, valves, controls, and associated Building Monitoring System alarms. The role is expected to support preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement of cooling performance to ensure optimal environmental conditions for critical IT operations.


This fast-paced role supports overall Data Center operations by maintaining and improving critical infrastructure through scheduled maintenance, ad hoc repairs, inspections, and technical troubleshooting, with particular attention to HVAC reliability, energy efficiency, operational resilience, and compliance with safety standards.


### **Leadership & Operational Excellence**


Demonstrate strong technical leadership by building an engaged, confident team and maintaining clear operational oversight. Provide weekly management updates on preventive maintenance, corrective actions, risks, upcoming work, and HVAC-related reliability priorities.


Proactively plan and lead engineering drills, review vendor reports, monitor cooling system trends, and conduct regular team meetings to address operational challenges, lessons learned, and continuous improvements across mechanical and environmental systems.


Maintain full ownership of the change management process by submitting and reviewing change requests within the agreed customer notice period, ensuring timely approvals, thorough risk assessments, MOP creation, and effective coordination with stakeholders and vendors to support safe, compliant, and resilient operations.


### **Responsibilities**


### **Regular Infrastructure Maintenance**


* Completes all maintenance protocols, plans, and site checks on time and accurately, including daily, weekly, and monthly inspections.
* Performs planned preventive and corrective maintenance on mechanical, electrical, HVAC, cooling, and special systems.
* Troubleshoots HVAC and environmental issues, including cooling performance, airflow, temperature and humidity control, alarms, leaks, and equipment faults.
* Supports the maintenance of chilled water systems, CRAC/CRAH units, air handling units, pumps, valves, controls, refrigeration components, and associated mechanical equipment.
* Makes minor changes to mechanical, electrical, HVAC, and special systems where required and within approved procedures.
* Addresses, reports, resolves, and investigates major failures, significant problems, and delays, contributing to root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.
* Ensures that sufficient spare parts are available on site for frequently used parts or parts with long lead times, maintaining an accurate critical spares register.
* Monitors and responds to BMS alarms in accordance with engineering policies and procedures, with particular attention to environmental and cooling-related alerts.
* Maintains plumbing and fire suppression systems.

### **Vendor Management**


* Coordinates with vendors to ensure maintenance activities are carried out in line with Equinix requirements, with a strong focus on HVAC, cooling, mechanical, and electrical infrastructure.
* Reviews vendor maintenance reports, service records, and recommendations related to HVAC systems, electrical systems, and critical facilities equipment.
* Edits and tracks the work approval process for service providers, including briefing at the start of work, control of work during the day, and final review of completed work.
* Recommends changes and updates to technical files for plant and equipment in cooperation with vendors and supervisors, ensuring as-built drawings and technical documentation remain accurate and up to date.

### **Process and Policy Administration**


* Creates engineering scripts, switching schedules, and method statements to support safe operations and planned maintenance activities.
* Ensures all Equinix safety standards are followed during HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and critical infrastructure maintenance.
* Ensures quality procedures related to preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, incident response, and change management are consistently applied.
* Supports correct incident management processes, especially for cooling degradation, HVAC alarms, electrical events, environmental deviations, and service-impacting infrastructure issues.
* Reviews processes, procedures, and systems, communicating deviations and proposed improvements to support operational resilience and continuous improvement.
* Develops training materials and supports training of Data Center employees in relevant engineering topics, with emphasis on HVAC maintenance, cooling reliability, BMS response, and safe electrical awareness.

### **Qualifications**


### **Knowledge and Experience**


* Strong hands-on experience in HVAC maintenance, mechanical systems, and cooling infrastructure, ideally within data centers, critical environments, industrial sites, hospitals, hotels, manufacturing plants, or large commercial buildings.
* Good working knowledge of chilled water systems, CRAC/CRAH units, air handling units, pumps, valves, controls, refrigeration components, airflow management, temperature and humidity control, and BMS alarm response.
* Solid understanding of electrical infrastructure and safe electrical working practices, including critical and non-critical power systems, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, and distribution equipment.
* Understanding of relevant codes, compliance regulations, safe work requirements, risk assessments, method statements, and permit-to-work processes.
* Familiarity with technical documents such as design drawings, schematics, data sheets, technical manuals, maintenance plans, and as-built documentation.
* Relevant experience may include building or facility maintenance, HVAC technician roles, mechanical maintenance, electrical maintenance, generator repair, aircraft mechanics, automotive mechanics, or other hands-on technical backgrounds.
* Refrigeration handling certification is preferred; electrical or mechanical license is also preferred.

### **Skills and Attributes**


* Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to diagnose and resolve HVAC, mechanical, environmental, and electrical infrastructure issues in a timely and safe manner.
* Able to perform all essential job functions, including walking, standing, bending, stooping, climbing, lifting, and manual dexterity, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Ability to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays when needed or required.
* Familiar with common applications needed to perform daily tasks, including CMMS, CRMs, productivity software, and drawing or drafting software.
* Skilled at working in alignment with relevant safety measures, operational procedures, and critical environment standards.
* Skilled at communicating with and managing vendors, especially for HVAC maintenance, cooling performance, electrical works, and technical service delivery.
* Able to communicate effectively with others, including oral and written instructions, incident reporting, maintenance updates, and escalation of technical risks.
* Knowledge of Swedish is considered a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving, teamwork, ownership, and continuous improvement skills.

title: Research Engineer in AI for Media and Language
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition.

**Description of the workplace**
--------------------------------


The position is at the Department of Computer Science within the division Robotics and Semantic Systems (RSS). The RSS division focuses on research and teaching in AI, Machine Learning, Robotics and Robotic Learning, Human-Robot Interaction, and Natural Language Processing. Together with the Dept. of Automatic Control, the division operates RobotLab LTH, which gives access to many types of robots.


You will collaborate closely with ML experts from both academia and industry, support international benchmarking challenges such as GENEA and VOT, and contribute to the annual WASP summer school on multimodal modelling of human communication. The position also gives access to first-class computing infrastructure, including the WARA Common computing centre and the Kebnekaise and Berzelius supercomputers, and offers opportunities to co-author scientific publications and shape the development of AI in media and language.


Your workplace is on Lund University's cohesive campus, where everything is close by, making it easy to meet, collaborate and exchange knowledge. The department strives for an open, inclusive and supportive work environment where colleagues with different backgrounds and perspectives learn from each other and celebrate each other's successes.

* More information about the Department of Computer Science
* More information about RSS
* More information about the RobotLab LTH
* More information about WARA M&L

**We offer**
------------


Lund University is a public authority which means that employees get particular benefits, generous annual leave and an advantageous occupational pension scheme.


Read more on the University website about being a Lund University employee
  

Work for us at Lund University

**Work duties**
---------------


As a Research Engineer in WARA Media and Language (WARA M&L), your primary duties are to design, implement and host a Machine Learning platform for the research community within WARA M&L. The platform will be supported by the resources provided from WARA Common, a sister arena within WASP and HPC2N (high performance computing cluster). The work covers all aspects of the platform construction: Interviews with partners from academia and industry, elaboration of needs, design and implementation of the system, management of data sets, hosting and sharing of data, providing data annotation services, benchmarking machine learning challenges and user support.


The work also involves providing technical support for the annual GENEA challenge and Online VOT benchmark. Apart from benchmarking challenges, you will also be working on the annual WASP Summer school event, where you will be implementing and developing student projects on multimodal modelling of human communication.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required qualifications for the position are:**
-------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field
* Practical and theoretical experience in Machine Learning
* Experience in software development
* Demonstrated ability to set up, configure, and maintain distributed development environments that support collaborative AI projects
* Experience designing and operating AI platform components, including resource management, data hosting, and data-sharing services
* Solid grounding in collecting, processing, and structuring data for AI workflows
* Experience with Linux-based system administration
* Programming experience, including shell scripting, Python, and working with APIs
* Basic knowledge of virtualization, networking, and computer security
* Experience working with containers (e.g., Docker, Singularity) and version control/CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub)
* Good collaborative skills and the ability to work in environments with both academic and industrial partners
* Ability to work independently, in a structured manner and with a problem-solving approach
* Good communication skills and the ability to provide support to users with varying technical backgrounds

**Additional qualifications for the position are:**
---------------------------------------------------

* Familiarity with front-end, back-end, JS frameworks, and database technologies
* Experience conducting scientific research in Machine Learning, AI, or a closely related field
* Experience providing technical support for ML/AI infrastructure, including troubleshooting for end-users (e.g., researchers) and authoring technical documentation
* Experience as a teaching assistant or in leading technical workshops and mentoring students on project-based work
* Experience with Unity, Blender, Unreal Engine, or Omniverse
* Experience with K8s, Docker Registry, Docker Swarm, or MLOps/AIOps frameworks
* Pedagogical ability, for example through experience of supervision, workshops or project-based student work
* Ability to contribute to an open, inclusive and supportive work environment
* Initiative and an interest in contributing to the development of research infrastructure and future AI applications


Consideration will also be given to how the applicant’s experience and skills complement and strengthen ongoing research within the department, and how they stand to contribute to its future development.

**Further information**
-----------------------


The position is a fixed term position for one year at 100% of full time, starting on October 1st 2026 or by agreement.

**How to apply**
----------------


A complete application must contain:

* A personal motivation letter describing why you are suitable for the advertised position
* Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* Other relevant information, such as documentation of software development experience, or publication list.
* Contact information to two persons willing to give references


The application must be submitted via the Varbi e-recruitment system no later than 2026-09-29. Further information can be obtained from Sonny Vu, e-mail xuan-son.vu@cs.lth.se.


Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard gender equality and diversity as a strength and an asset.


We look forward to your application!


LTH is Lund University’s Faculty of Engineering. At LTH we educate people, build knowledge for the future and work hard for the development of society. We create space for brilliant research and inspire creative advancements in technology, architecture and design. We have nearly 12,000 students. Every year, our researchers – many of whom work in world-leading profile areas – publish around 100 theses and 2 000 scientific findings. In addition, a number of research results and degree projects are transformed into innovations. Together we explore and create – to benefit the world.


We kindly decline all sales and marketing contacts.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**
------------------------


We build Radio Units (RUs) that work as high-speed, secure, jam-resistant data pipelines for defence and dual-use applications — the connective tissue for UAV C2, deployable 5G, and tactical awareness systems.


Our pipeline is full of customers — defence primes, armed forces, industrial operators — who are excited about what our RU could do for them. **The bottleneck isn't interest. It's that we don't have enough hands to sit with those customers, understand their actual problem, build something that proves it, and spot the patterns before anyone else does so we can feed them into our product roadmap.** That's the job. You'll be the person who turns "this is interesting, let's talk again" into "we've seen it work, here's a contract."

**What you'll actually do**
---------------------------

* Sit in rooms with customers — sometimes a defence prime's systems architect, sometimes a signals officer, sometimes both — and figure out what they actually need (which is rarely what they first asked for).
* Scope and build PoCs and demos that integrate our RU with whatever the customer cares about: cameras, radars, microphones, ground stations on one end; data lakes, AI tooling, C2 software on the other.
* Do the integration work end-to-end. That means wiring a physical kit on Monday, debugging a MAVLink message on Tuesday, writing Python to push sensor data into a customer's stack on Wednesday, and demoing the whole thing on Thursday.
* Travel to customer sites in the US and across Europe. Sometimes you'll deploy and run a demo in the field. Sometimes you'll spend a week embedded with a prime's engineering team.
* Feed what you learn back into product. The patterns you find — the integrations customers keep asking for, the operational constraints that keep showing up — are how we figure out what to build next.
* Work directly with our CEO on the highest-priority opportunities. Until our CCO is in seat, you'll be operating with a lot of autonomy and short feedback loops.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**This is a hybrid role — equally happy soldering a cable and writing the Python that ingests what comes out of it. We don't expect you to have done all of the below, but you should be credibly strong on most of it:**

* Full-stack engineering instincts. You've built things end-to-end and you don't wait for someone else to define the interface.
* Hardware comfort. RF, comms, sensors, embedded systems — you've been around it. You're not scared of an oscilloscope or a radio link budget.
* Software fluency. Python is table stakes. You've worked with data pipelines, APIs, and at least one of the things our customers care about: drone autopilots (MAVLink, STANAG 4586), sensor fusion, edge processing, AI/ML inference at the edge, ground control stations.
* Customer-facing presence. You can sit in front of a colonel, a procurement officer, or a prime's chief engineer and earn their trust. You don't need a script.
* A bias for shipping. You've built demos and prototypes under time pressure. You know the difference between "demo-good" and "production-good" and you make the right call for the situation.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Customer says something vague. You don't wait for it to get clearer — you go figure out what they actually mean.


We're open on seniority. If you're 4 years in and exceptional, we want to talk. If you're 10 years in and want to be hands-on at a stage where what you build defines the company, we want to talk.

**Background that fits**
------------------------

**This is illustrative, not a checklist:**

* **Integration engineers from drone, robotics, or autonomy companies** (typically Payload Integration, Flight Software, Ground Systems, or Integration Engineers at Auterion, Tekever, Quantum Systems, and similar) who've done real customer integration work.
* **Forward Deployed / Mission Engineers** from neo-defence companies (typically FDEs or FDSEs at Palantir; Mission Operations, Mission Software, or Mission Deployment Engineers at Anduril; and equivalent customer-facing engineers at Shield AI, Tekever, or similar).
* **Engineers from RF, comms, or satellite companies** (typically Firmware, Baseband, RF Systems, or Systems Integration Engineers at Bittium, Sivers Semiconductors, Gapwaves, Ericsson, Mynaric, or comms divisions at Saab, Leonardo, L3Harris, and Thales).
* **Ex-military signals, EW, or comms officers** (Signals Officers, Communications Officers, Electronic Warfare Officers, or Combat Systems Engineers) who've moved into engineering roles and miss being close to operators.
* **Engineers from defence primes' rapid prototyping or skunkworks teams** (typically Capability, Systems, Prototyping, or Applied Research Engineers) who are tired of the pace.

**What we're not looking for**
------------------------------

* Solutions Engineers from SaaS who are used to a defined demo script and a clean handoff to a CSM.
* Pure researchers or lab engineers who haven't shipped to real users.
* Career salespeople with a technical veneer.
* People who need a fully scoped backlog before they can start.

**What you'll get**
-------------------

* A seat at the table while we build the commercial function from scratch. The PoCs you build will define our product roadmap and our first multi-million-euro contracts.
* Direct working relationship with the CEO and the rest of the founding team.
* Real customers from week one. We have live opportunities in UAV C2 and deployable 5G that need an FDE on them today.
* Equity that reflects the impact. You'll be one of the first commercial hires.
* Salary commensurate with experience — we'll calibrate to your level and the market.

By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Team Lead**Your role and responsibilities**

title: Calibration Engineer – Powetrain
description:
ALTEN is partnering with a global leader in hybrid engines and transmissions, to find talented professionals for their cutting-edge projects in Sweden. These roles are on-site and offer the opportunity to work with a pioneering team developing next-generation powertrain solutions for a global market.

  

About the role


As a Calibration Leader, you will take the lead on projects lasting from a few months to a year, focusing on planning, prioritizing, and tracking project progress. Your work will revolve around emissions, attributes, performance, and OBD (On-Board Diagnostics). You will collaborate closely with internal teams and present findings and updates to both internal and external stakeholders, including customers. Additionally, you will be responsible for budget estimation, tracking, and balancing throughout the project lifecycle.

  

As a Calibration Engineer (Fuel/Evap Diagnostics), you will be responsible for performing calibration of engine control or diagnostic systems during all project phases. This includes physical testing, simulation, and analysis to optimize calibrations in line with project and customer requirements. You will also contribute to the development and improvement of calibration and testing methods.


Your main responsibilities


For the Calibration Leader:


* Lead projects from initiation to completion, ensuring timely delivery
* Plan, prioritize, and monitor project progress
* Focus on emissions, attributes, performance, and OBD
* Facilitate internal coordination and communication
* Present project updates and results to customers
* Manage budget estimation, tracking, and balancing
  

For the Calibration Engineer:


* Develop methods for optimal and robust calibration during a project
* Perform calibration, testing, and optimization of engine control/diagnostic systems
* Conduct tests and analysis to ensure system performance
* Update and evaluate Sign-Off documents
* Use Design of Experiments (DoE) to plan and evaluate tests when applicable
* Identify issues and recommend solutions
* Assess the need for analysis and verification activities
  

Your profile


We are looking for responsible, driven, and technically skilled professionals with a strong background in calibration, project management, and powertrain development.


* Relevant engineering degree (BSc or equivalent) or equivalent experience
* Proven experience in project leadership or 2+ years in the automotive industry
* Experience in powertrain development
* Experience in powertrain software development
* Understanding of attributes, emissions, and OBD
* General knowledge of powertrain control strategies
* Data analysis and programming skills
* Driver’s License B

Meritorious:


* INCA experience
* Hällered T1/T2
  

About ALTEN


ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities – from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.

  

For the sixth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.

title: Senior ASIC Verification Engineer, Lund
description:
**Job Title**
-------------

Senior ASIC Verification Engineer, Lund
**Job Description**
-------------------


*Do you want to work with the core of a global tech company's business? How would it feel to be in a team that verifies that one thing our product portfolio depends on? With us in the ASIC verification team, you will be able to do just that! We are now looking for passionate senior engineers to join our group of dedicated and competent ASIC* *Verification Engineers* *!*


**The ASIC Verification Team**


Our team is responsible for pre-silicon verification of the in-house developed hardware IPs and subsystems . We take pride in delivering top-quality work using the latest verification techniques. As a team member, you will have ample opportunities to learn and grow in a creative and collaborative environment.


Axis has a long history of developing integrated circuits for our products. The series of ARTPEC chips is a cornerstone in most Axis products, as discussed here: Axis System-On-Chip , and ARTPEC-9 . The ASIC department is currently working on developing the 10 th generation of the ARPTEC SoC using the most modern chip technology available. See also The history of ARTPEC .


The ASIC verification team ensures that the ARTPEC chips are working correctly , before they materialize into an actual chip . To do this, we use simulation as well as formal methods. Verifying complex chip designs requires the use of specialized and advanced techniques.


The team is working on a wide variety of modules and subsystems. As we work with agile methods, you will be part of a group that collaborates closely to meet our goals.  



**About you**


We are looking for a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science , Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field . Y ou should have experience from at least a couple of projects developing sophisticated compute subsystems or SoCs , ranging from specification and modelling phase to tape out .  



  

Y ou will need:


* Solid understanding of digital hardware Verilog HDL and Verification strategies including, SystemVerilog , UVM and Hardware/Firmware co-verification.
* E xperience in complex SoC architecture and development including multi-clock domain designs, AXI/A P B protocols, multi-power domains, and reset architectures.
* Experience with Python, Tcl, or other scripting language.
* Experience verifying SoC projects or systems including embedded microprocessors.
Bonus points for :


* End to end formal verification and formal property verification
* Clock domain crossing verification and connectivity checking
* Power aware verification
* Transaction Level Modeling (TLM) and SystemC
You enjoy sharing your knowledge and ideas with co-workers . You want to be part of a competent and creative team that loves to solve problems together , and we are sure that we are that team!


**Your role**
  

We emphasize continuous growth of expertise and responsibilities for each team member , and the team as a whole. Part of this requires continuously following new developments in ASIC verification since this field continues to develop rapidly. W ork tasks may therefore include investigating new verification technologies or evaluating new tools. Depending on personal interest, t here are opportunities to write papers and present at international conferences.


Our verification flow and environments are quite advanced. D eveloping and maintaining them require s a good understanding of digital hardware as well as software engineering principles. In particular, we make extensive use of object-oriented frameworks. Debugging and identifying potential problems in the hardware design is also a fundamental part of the job.


Our in-house developed hardware often implements functions such as image processing, graphical transfor m s , general AI and computer vision. As a verification engineer, you will have the opportunity to grow your knowledge related to such algorithms.


**What Axis has to offer**


We are a world leader in network video , where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.


Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.


As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.


Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.


To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:


Life at Axis blog


Engineering at Axis blog


Innovation at Axis


**Ready to act?**
  

We hope you are really inspired by the job description and found a potential match! We are looking forward to receiving your application!


If you have any questions, get in touch with Per Dagermo, Engineering Manager for the ASIC Verification team, at +46 46 272 1800 .  



*We review applications continuously so don´t wait to send in your application!*


*This recruitment is handled solely by Axis Communications AB, and we politely but firmly decline all calls from recruitment and consulting companies regarding this position.*  



**Type of Employment**
----------------------


Permanent Employment
**Posting End Date**
--------------------


2026-10-12
*Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments.* *Notice will be provided before we take any action.*

**About Axis Communications**
-----------------------------


We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.


With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.


**Let´s create a smarter, safer world**

title: Sr. Fullstack Engineer – Backend | Content Experience
description:
At TV4, technology, innovation, news journalism, sports and entertainment come together.
   

  

 Every week, around eight million people use TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo. Content Experience is responsible for the experience from the moment users log in until they press play: how people discover content, navigate the service and find something they actually want to watch.
   

  

 We are now looking for a
 **Sr Fullstack Engineer with a backend focus** 
 who wants to help develop the technical foundation behind those experiences.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 Content Experience is the part of TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo that users interact with when looking for something to watch. A large and constantly changing catalogue of content needs to be easy to discover, navigate and choose from.
   

  

 Behind that experience are backend services and APIs that need to handle large volumes of content and traffic quickly and reliably. They also need to work seamlessly with other systems across our technical platform.
   

  

 We build our new backend services in
 **Go** 
 and continue to evolve the architecture behind Content Experience. You will work on technically complex problems where what you build has a clear and direct impact on the user experience.
   

  

**Why you might want to join us**
 You enjoy complex technical problems, but also want to understand the product and the users behind them. You are comfortable working across the stack when the problem requires it.
   

  

 You like understanding systems in depth, making pragmatic technical tradeoffs and building solutions that work reliably in production. You enjoy taking responsibility from problem and hypothesis through implementation, follow up and continued development.
   

  

 You see AI as a natural part of modern software development and are curious about how new tools and ways of working are changing how good engineering is done.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Content Experience is a cross functional team where engineering works closely with product and design. We also collaborate with other engineering teams to connect our services with the rest of TV4's technical platform.
   

  

 The team has significant technical ownership and is responsible for its solutions all the way to production.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design, build and evolve backend services and APIs, with Go as the primary language for new development
* Build technical solutions for discovery, navigation and content presentation
* Integrate with services and platforms across TV4's technology organisation
* Work with distributed systems where performance, availability and scalability matter
* Take responsibility for what you build from implementation through production, observability and continued development
* Work across the stack when the problem requires it and contribute to our React and TypeScript based clients
* Drive technical initiatives and contribute to architecture and technology decisions
* Use AI tools as a natural part of the development process


**About You**
 You are an experienced fullstack engineer with a clear backend focus and mature engineering judgement. You can navigate complex systems, understand what actually needs to be solved and make well founded technical decisions even when the problem is not fully defined.
   

  

 You care about why you are building something, not just how. You take responsibility for what you build all the way to production and are comfortable balancing system design, quality, reliability and long term sustainability.
   

  

 We believe you:
   

  

* Have deep experience in backend development within modern production systems
* Have worked with APIs, integrations and distributed systems
* Are comfortable working in cloud based environments and with modern engineering practices
* Have a strong understanding of system design, performance, reliability and observability
* Are comfortable with frontend development and can work across the stack when the problem requires it
* Can move between the bigger picture and technical detail
* Understand that technical decisions involve tradeoffs and look for pragmatic solutions
* Communicate clearly and work well in a cross functional product team
* Use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering work


 You do not need to already be a Go specialist. If you have strong experience in modern backend development and are used to quickly learning new languages and technical environments, that is equally relevant.
   

  

 It is a plus if you have experience with:
   

  

* Go
* React and TypeScript
* GraphQL
* Streaming or media platforms
* Search, recommendation systems or personalised user experiences
* High traffic, distributed consumer systems


**Current Tech Stack**
**Backend:** 
 Go, Node.js
   

  

**Frontend:** 
 React, React Native, TypeScript
   

  

**Cloud:** 
 AWS
   

  

**Databases:** 
 PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
   

  

**DevOps & Observability:** 
 GitHub Actions, Terraform, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
   

  

**AI & Developer Tooling:** 
 Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, CLI/MCP integrations
   

  

**Productivity:** 
 Linear, Notion, Slack
   

  

**What TV4 Offers**
* Short paths from idea to decision in a senior technology organisation with high autonomy for both teams and individuals
* The opportunity to influence how millions of users discover and engage with content
* A culture that values sustainable technical solutions over quick fixes
* Colleagues with strong technical expertise and a high degree of ownership
* The ability to properly disconnect after work. We have dedicated on call arrangements with voluntary participation and do not expect you to be available outside working hours
* A modern office with gym, restaurant, parking garage and rooftop terrace
* Collective agreement, occupational pension, insurance, wellness allowance, Benify benefits, your choice of phone and a MacBook Pro


**Practical information**
* The role is based in Stockholm
* TV4 is office first, and we normally work from the office four days per week
* This is a permanent position with a six month probationary period
* The position is covered by our collective agreement with Unionen
* A background check is part of the recruitment process


 We review applications and conduct interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Senior Androidutvecklare till polisbilen
description:
**Organisation** 
 It-avdelningen
 **Kommun** 
 Stockholm
 **Län** 
 Stockholms län
 **Utlyst** 
 15 september 2026
 **Ansök senast** 
 5 oktober 2026
 **Referensnummer** 
 PB1458/2026
   

  

 Arbetsplatsbeskrivning
   

  

 Kombinera ditt intresse för Androidutveckling med ett uppdrag av yttersta vikt. Som del av vårt team får vara med och forma tekniken i framtidens polisbil, där innovation möter samhällsansvar
   

  

 Att jobba på polisens IT-avdelning är att vara en avgörande del i polisens verksamhet och det brottsbekämpande arbetet. Oavsett om det handlar om att utveckla nya operativa appar, forensisk teknologi eller att samla digitala bevis krävs väl fungerande IT-lösningar.
   

  

 Tjänsten som Androidutvecklare är placerad i gruppen Fordonssystem och vårt uppdrag är att säkerställa att poliserna i yttre tjänst har bästa möjliga IT-stöd i den nya generationens polisbilar. Vi har en modern och världsunik IT-plattform i de nya bilarna som blir ett kraftfullt redskap för att förbättra skyddet av egen personal och utrustning samt förbättra polisens förmåga att förebygga, utreda och lagföra brott.
   

  

 I projektet får du vara med och knyta ihop hela kedjan från komplex teknik till färdig slutprodukt för våra användare i fält.
   

  

 Du kommer att ha din placering centralt på Kungsholmen i Stockholm, och det finns möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till två dagar i veckan. Som statligt anställd på Polismyndigheten erbjuds du särskilda förmåner kring pension, föräldralön, friskvård m.m. Läs mer om våra förmåner och villkor här: polisen.se/jobb-och-utbildning/polisen-som-arbetsplats/det-har-erbjuder-vi/
   

  

 Arbetsbeskrivning
   

  

 Som androidutvecklare på polisens IT arbetar du i en agil miljö där arbetsklimatet genomsyras av högt engagemang och driv. I rollen kommer du att ansvara för hela livscykeln, från nyutveckling och vidareutveckling till löpande förvaltning, av flera kritiska produkter. Ditt huvudsakliga fokus kommer ligga på att bygga upp nästa generations mjukvaruplattform på Android i polisbilen.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat omfatta att:
   

  

* Vara ledande i framtagande av en ny androidplattform för polisbilen
* Designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla Androidapplikationer i Kotlin för polisbilen
* Arbeta nära UX, backend och andra mobila utvecklare
* Driva arkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå operativa behov
* Arbeta med säker kommunikation och autentisering


 Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba med att utveckla mobila lösningar för polisens verksamhet, läs mer via följande länk där en av medarbetarna i teamet, Zara, berättar om sin arbetsvardag: polisen.se/jobb-och-utbildning/jobba-hos-polisen/jobb-it-avdelningen/sagt-om-jobbet/zara-apputvecklare/
   

  

 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Detta är en möjlighet för dig som har:
   

  

* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT. Alternativt motsvarande förvärvad erfarenhet som Polismyndigheten bedömer som likvärdigt.
* Flerårig relevant och aktuell erfarenhet av Androidutveckling, företrädesvis från en stor organisation
* Gedigen kompetens inom centrala delar av Android-plattformen, specifikt livscykelhantering, navigationsstrukturer och moderna arkitekturkomponenter.
* Erfarenhet av att jobba med CI/CD och versionshantering i Git
* Erfarenhet av Jetpack Compose
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
* Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap


 Följande är särskilt meriterande:
   

  

* Yrkeserfarenhet av att ha medverkat vid införande av Androidutveckling i en organisation och/eller verkat minst något år som tech lead för ett Androidutvecklingsteam.


 Det är meriterande om du även har:
   

  

* Relevant yrkeserfarenhet av hårdvarunära utveckling knutet till Android-enheter
* Grundläggande kunskap eller erfarenhet av iOS-utveckling (Swift eller SwiftUI)
* God kompetens kring att ta fram lösningsarkitektur
* Certifikat och PKI
* Utveckling med hårda krav på kvalitet och av prestandakritiska IT-system

title: Konsult till våra försvarskunder!
description:
Vill du arbeta som konsult inom försvarsindustrin och bidra till ett säkrare och mer robust samhälle, samtidigt som du utvecklar din tekniska kompetens tillsammans med vassa kollegor på HiQ?
   

  

 Vi söker nu fler ingenjörer som vill jobba med avancerad produkt- och systemutveckling mot försvarssektorn. Hos oss kan du arbeta både inom mjukvaruutveckling, systemintegration och hårdvarunära lösningar, beroende på din profil och intresseområden.
   

  

 Här kan dina uppdrag handla om allt från utveckling av realtidssystem, integrationslösningar och kommunikationssystem till testautomatisering, felsökning och konfiguration av komplexa miljöer. Vi samarbetar med flera ledande aktörer inom försvarsindustrin, och som konsult hos oss får du möjlighet att ta dig an olika typer av uppdrag över tid, i team eller i mer självständiga roller.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Som konsult hos HiQ inom försvarsområdet kommer du exempelvis att kunna arbeta med:
   

  

* Utveckling av robusta system i främst Java, C++ eller C#
* Integration av delsystem och gränssnitt i större tekniska plattformar
* Hårdvarunära och inbyggda lösningar i säkerhetskritiska miljöer
* Testautomatisering, CI/CD och DevOps
* Felsökning, konfigurering och prestandaoptimering av komplexa system


 Du blir en del av ett nätverk av erfarna kollegor där kunskapsdelning, enkelhet och prestigelöst samarbete är centralt. Beroende på uppdrag arbetar du antingen i kundens team, i team med HiQ-kollegor eller i hybridlösningar.
   

  

 Vem vi tror att du är
   

  

 För att trivas hos oss och i våra uppdrag mot försvarsindustrin tror vi att du:
   

  

* Är ingenjör med djup förståelse för teknik och har några års arbetslivserfarenhet
* Är nyfiken på försvarssektorn, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att sätta dig in i komplexa system
* Trivs både som en del av ett team och med att ta eget ansvar
* Har lätt för att kommunicera och bygga förtroende med både kollegor och kunder
* Gillar att leverera med hög kvalitet och ser det som självklart att hjälpa kunden att lyckas


 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* Högskole-/Civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik eller motsvarande
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling, gärna inom Java, C++ eller C#
* Erfarenhet av något eller flera av följande områden:
+ Testautomatisering och test av komplexa system
+ DevOps, CI/CD, script och verktygskedjor
+ Systemintegration, felsökning och konfigurering
+ Inbyggda/hårdvarunära system eller realtidssystem är starkt meriterande

* Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både tal och skrift
* Möjlighet att arbeta på plats på kontoret 3–5 dagar i veckan


 Då många av våra uppdrag kan omfattas av sekretess krävs svenskt medborgarskap samt att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll.
   

  

 Varför HiQ?
   

  

 Sedan 1995 har HiQ förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi fokuserar på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna.
   

  

 Vi HiQare är stolta över en kultur präglad av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra mål och på att hjälpa varandra att växa. Hos oss får du:
   

  

* Spännande uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin med modern teknik
* Möjlighet att fördjupa dig eller bredda dig – från utveckling till integration och hårdvarunära
* Kollegor som gärna delar med sig av erfarenheter och kunskap
* Möjlighet att både lära, leda och inspirera andra


*I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut.*
 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: ADMS Core & Solutions Engineer
description:
**ADMS Core & Solutions Engineer – ADMS Series 6**
 Göteborg/Malmø, Sweden
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an ADMS Core & Solutions Engineer, you will make an impact by designing, deploying, upgrading, and optimizing ADMS Series 6 environments that support critical utility operations across Europe.
   

  

 You will be a valued member of our Energy & Utilities Technology team and work collaboratively with utility stakeholders, ADMS architects, infrastructure specialists, and engineering teams to deliver resilient, scalable, and highly available operational technology solutions.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to work on some of the most technically complex utility modernization programs in the industry, including new ADMS implementations, platform upgrades, and large-scale system consolidation initiatives. Whether you're an experienced ADMS engineer or a technically strong professional looking to deepen your expertise in utility operations technology, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead the deployment and upgrade of ADMS Series 6 environments, including planning, execution, validation, and production readiness activities.
* Collaborate with utility stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable ADMS solution designs.
* Design, implement, and optimize ADMS solutions to improve grid reliability, operational efficiency, and system performance.
* Manage the setup and configuration of ADMS replication groups to ensure data consistency and synchronization across environments.
* Implement best practices for high availability, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
* Monitor replication performance and troubleshoot cross-environment synchronization issues.
* Perform end-to-end defect analysis, root cause investigation, and remediation coordination.
* Develop and execute FAT/SAT test strategies for new features, upgrades, and system enhancements.
* Partner with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and OEM teams to maintain secure and compliant platform operations.


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
   

  

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* 3+ years of experience in ADMS, SCADA, utility applications, operational technology, software engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* Experience deploying, configuring, upgrading, or supporting enterprise-scale software platforms.
* Knowledge of distributed systems, solution architecture, and system integration principles.
* Experience troubleshooting complex production issues and performing root cause analysis.
* Working knowledge of operating systems, databases, and enterprise application environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and stakeholder groups.


**These Will Help You Stand Out**
* Experience with ADMS, SCADA, DMS, EMS, or utility management platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Linux, SQL, and Python.
* Experience with Docker, Jenkins, or other automation and deployment tools.
* Understanding of software architecture and solution design principles.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, and replication technologies.
* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Background in utilities, energy management, smart grid technologies, or critical infrastructure environments.


 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Senior Electronics Design Engineer - erfaren elektronikkonstruktör till växande utvecklingsteam
description:
**Elektronikingenjör** 




  





*Bli en del av BitSim NOW – ett teknikdrivet designhus och konsultbolag specialiserat på elektronik, bildbehandling, FPGA och inbyggda system. Vi fokuserar på högpresterande bildsystem och datainsamling, där höga krav på hastighet, energiförbrukning och upplösning driver innovation framåt.* 




*Eftersom de flesta projekt hanteras internt erbjuder vi en kreativ miljö där idéer snabbt blir verklighet. På BitSim NOW arbetar specialister inom elektronik, mjukvara, FPGA, vision och maskininlärning sida vid sida för att skapa avancerad teknik. Du välkomnas till en öppen och inkluderande kultur med engagerade kollegor och en arbetsplats präglad av innovation och samarbete. Här arbetar utvecklare inom elektronik, mjukvara och FPGA tillsammans med experter inom vision och maskininlärning. Vi tror att verklig innovation uppstår när olika kompetensområden möts och lär av varandra – samtidigt som man har roligt. Vi är drygt 40 ingenjörer med olika bakgrunder och kompetenser – förenade av en gemensam drivkraft: att tillsammans bygga riktigt bra teknik.* 




  





*Vi söker nu en skicklig elektronikingenjör inom utveckling som vill bli en del av vårt växande team. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta med en bredd av kunddrivna utvecklingsprojekt inom avancerad elektronik och sensorsystem. Du erbjuds en stimulerande och varierad tjänst där du samarbetar med våra erfarna konstruktörer, som stöttar dig i ditt arbete och bidrar till din kontinuerliga utveckling.* 




*Som person ser vi att du har ett starkt tekniskt intresse, tycker om att lösa tekniska problem, är utåtriktad och uppskattar kundkontakt.* 




  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 



* Konstruktion av scheman och PCB-design
* Utveckling av avancerad elektronik för kamera- och sensorsystem
* EMC-testning, verifiering och felsökning
* Utveckling med mikroprocessorer, FPGA och System-on-Chip (SoC)
* Nära samarbete med kunder, leverantörer och interna utvecklingsteam



  





 Merparten av utvecklingen sker internt, vilket ger helhetsförståelse på systemnivå och snabba utvecklingscykler. Vi hanterar komplexa utvecklingsprojekt och har ett nära samarbete med våra leverantörer för att möjliggöra korta ledtider i produktionen.
 



  





**Kvalifikationer** 



* Civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom elektronik, datateknik, mekatronik, maskinteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande
* Gedigen erfarenhet av elektronikdesign
* Erfarenhet av PCB-layout, schemaritning och simuleringsverktyg
* Erfarenhet av EMC- och säkerhetstestning
* ***Svenskt medborgarskap***
* ***Krav på minst* 
 3 års erfarenhet**
* ***Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska***



  





**Det är starkt meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:** 



* Bare metal eller RTOS
* FPGA-utveckling (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog)
* Maskininlärning / AI
* Mekatronik



  





**Bli en del av vårt team – där du står i fokus! 🌟** 




 Vi är en mångsidig grupp ingenjörer med bred kompetens och erfarenhet. Här får du möjlighet att växa, experimentera och utvecklas! Vi värdesätter innovation, gemenskap och en platt organisation där alla kan vara sig själva. Självklart arbetar vi efter starka värderingar och erbjuder en arbetsmiljö där du känner dig uppskattad.
 



  





**Detta erbjuder vi:** 



* Möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor
* Vidareutbildning och utvecklingsmöjligheter
* Eget labb med 3D-skrivare och utvecklingsverktyg
* Utrymme för egna idéer och projekt
* En platt organisation – var dig själv!
* Vi älskar tekniknördar och är fortfarande woke!

title: Embedded- och elektronikutvecklare till Prevas Stockholm
description:
**Är du vår nästa kollega inom embedded och elektronikutveckling?**
 På Prevas tror vi på att teknik kan förändra världen till det bättre. Vi söker dig som vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss och som trivs nära tekniken, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt ligger på mjukvara, hårdvara eller i samspelet mellan dem. I rollen kan du arbeta både i våra in-houseprojekt och ute hos kunder. Du blir en del av ett samarbetsdrivet team där teknik, nyfikenhet och kreativitet kombineras för att skapa verkligt värde.
   

  

 Hos oss finns välutrustade elektronik- och mekaniklabb samt möjlighet att arbeta med hela utvecklingskedjan, från krav och arkitektur till prototyp, verifiering och färdig produkt.
   

  

**Vi tror att du är någon som:**
* Kommunicerar öppet och bygger långsiktiga relationer
* Trivs med att arbeta i team och dela kunskap med andra
* Angriper tekniska utmaningar strukturerat och lösningsorienterat
* Har förståelse för kunders behov och helhetsperspektiv
* Har minst 4 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling eller elektronikkonstruktion


**Om programmering är din grej tror vi att du har:**
* Erfarenhet av C och eller C++, gärna i kombination med exempelvis Python, Bash eller C#.
* Erfarenhet av RTOS, firmwareutveckling eller hårdvarunära programmering
* Vana av versionshanteringsverktyg


**Om du är mer för elektronikkonstruktion tror vi att du har:**
* Erfarenhet av elektronikkonstruktion på kortnivå
* Arbetat med krav, schema, layout, prototypframtagning och verifiering
* Erfarenhet av industrialisering, test eller produktionssättning är meriterande
* Vana av CAD verktyg för elektronik, exempelvis Altium


**Vad vi erbjuder**
 Hos Prevas får du mer än bara ett jobb, du blir en del av en gemenskap, och vi erbjuder en arbetsmiljö som främjar balans mellan arbete och fritid. Våra sociala aktiviteter är lika varierade som våra medarbetare, från brädspelskvällar och bågskytte till kreativa utflykter och gemensamma utmaningar. Här finns plats för olika personligheter, intressen och karriärvägar.
   

  

 Vårt största kontor ligger i Sundbyberg, där vi har våra egna labb och de största ytorna men det finns också möjlighet att emellanåt sitta på vårt hemtrevliga kypin på Södermalm med viss "vattenglimt" och utsikt mot Gamla Stan och Djurgården.
   

  

**Vill du veta mer?**
 Slå oss en signal eller kom förbi på en kopp kaffe. Vi träffar gärna nya kollegor och berättar mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss.

title: SAP Transformation(S/4HANA) Consultant - Sweden
description:
**Role** 
 – Industry Principal/ S/4 Hana Consultant
   

  

**Technology** 
 – SAP Transformation (S/4HANA)
   

  

**Location** 
 – Sweden
   

  

**Compensation** 
 – Competitive (including bonus)
   

  

**Job Description**
 Today, the corporate landscape is dynamic and the world ahead is full of possibilities! None of the amazing things we do at Infosys would be possible without an equally amazing culture, the environment where ideas can flourish and where you are empowered to move forward as far as your ideas will take you.
   

  

 At Infosys, we assure that your career will never stand still, we will inspire you to build what’s next and we will navigate further together. Our journey of learnability, values and trusted relationships with our clients continue to be the cornerstones of our organization and these values are upheld only because of our people.
   

  

**Your role**
 Infosys is seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Industry Principal – SAP (IPCON) to join our expanding European SAP practice. This is a senior leadership role requiring deep SAP expertise, strong business acumen, and a proven track record in steering complex transformation programs.
   

  

 As an Industry Principal, you will shape SAP transformation vision, lead client engagements at the highest levels, architect end to end solutions, and ensure delivery excellence across SAP S/4HANA programs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead SAP solutions across multiple end-to-end implementations and transformation programs.
* Drive client engagements from Phase 0 through execution, including Greenfield, Brownfield, and Hybrid S/4HANA projects.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders (Business and IT) to define roadmaps, assess readiness, and build transformation strategies.
* Utilize SAP toolchain for implementation, administration, and optimization.
* Prepare solution proposals, effort estimations, and contribute to RFP responses.
* Mentor and manage project teams, ensuring delivery quality and adherence to timelines.
* Represent Infosys in client meetings with professionalism and strong interpersonal communication.
* Stay current with SAP innovations and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.
* Set and govern the SAP architecture vision across the service line, ensuring alignment with client business strategy, SAP roadmap (e.g., S/4HANA, BTP, RISE), and enterprise standards while balancing innovation, scalability, and cost.
* Lead and mentor the SAP architect community, establishing best practices, reference architectures, and quality gates across delivery, pre sales, and transformation programs to drive consistency and technical excellence.
* Any patent, IP external publication (research papers) will be an added advantage.
* Act as a trusted advisor to CxOs and senior stakeholders, shaping end to end transformation strategies, influencing deal architecture and value propositions, and de risking large, complex SAP programs.


**Skill Required**
* Deep functional (SAP Finance/Manufacturing/Logistics/Sales) or technical skills (ABAP, Integration, Security, Basis) in one or two SAP ERP skills.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, EWM, TM, Business AI, LeanIX, Signavio, Cloud ALM
* Hands-on SAP consulting experience.
* Minimum of 4 full lifecycle SAP project implementations.
* Experience in leading teams in SAP projects.
* Exposure to at least two types of S/4HANA projects: Greenfield, Brownfield, or Hybrid.
* Experience in transformation preparation or Phase 0 activities.
* Proficiency in SAP toolchain usage or administration.
* Valid SAP certification in relevant skill areas.
* Strong client-facing skills with the ability to engage middle management effectively.
* Proven ability to build solution proposals and estimate efforts accurately.
* Demonstrated flexibility, team spirit, and a results-driven mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to multiple SAP modules or skill areas within the SAP product portfolio.
* Publications or thought leadership in SAP or industry-specific domains.


**About Infosys**
 Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 56 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through the many next of their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
   

  

 Visit www.infosys.com to see how Infosys can help your enterprise navigate your next.
   

  

 All aspects of the hiring process and employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
